I am a 53 yo WF diagnosed with lupus in my 20s. I wanted to share my experience with the second dose of Moderna vaccine.   I received the second Moderna vaccine at 10:30 am February 8th.  Around 5 pm, I started feeling unwell. By 9 pm I had an unbearable headache, neck pain, ear pain and jaw pain.  I had overall stiffness and muscle/joint pain much like a significant lupus flare. Specific movement involving my left rib cage caused a stabbing pain from the location of a healed rib fracture which occurred in January 2019.  During that night, I slept little and struggled to adjust my head /neck position in hopes of finding comfort.  I have cervical stenosis maintained by exercise but it felt like the nerves in my neck were being crushed.  I recognized all of the symptoms as exaggerated reactions of inflammatory processes I had experienced over the past year.   I have been on Prednisone for 10 years with 5 mg(my current dose) being the lowest dose.  I took 10mg Prednisone around 2 am. Around 6 am, I had some relief through the use of heat and ice on my neck and slept for a few hours.   I took 10 mg Prednisone twice more during the second day.  I spent the remainder of the day in bed or on the couch with more bearable inflammatory symptoms. After sleeping all night the second night, I awoke still feeling groggy and at the same discomfort level. I feel more fatigue and weakness.
